title: An Autoethnographic Case Study of Generative Artificial Intelligence’s Utility for Accessibility

bias_targets.methodology: Autoethnographic case study where a team of researchers with and without disabilities prompted generative AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Midjourney) for everyday personal and professional tasks, qualitatively documenting and analyzing the outputs for ableist tropes, inaccurate representations of assistive technologies, and failures in accessible design.
